quotes.text: What we have proven already, regardless of what happens November 3rd, is that it's possible to win a primary election standing with working people, not taking a dime of a PAC or crypto or big AI money,

Big AI is driving up our electric bills while buying influence in Washington. Angela supports a moratorium on new data center construction until there are real federal protections for workers, ratepayers, and communities, not more blank checks for Silicon Valley.

I support a national moratorium on new AI data centers until we know more about their operation and impact and can develop strong regulations to protect our air, water, energy resources, workers, and communities. People come before profit. Technological advancement and economic development should never happen at the expense of public health.
While Jimmy Gomez is taking another L, we're raising money to get big AI and AIPAC money out of our politics. Join us! https://t.co/ZSbs5fMyIA

I think you'd be even more surprised to see how much Big AI has pledged to back him — while some of us are on the front lines of resisting data centers in our community and pushing for a nationwide moratorium. https://t.co/Ga4qpWymha

California’s 34th congressional district is dealing with the aftermath of the recent Lineage Logistics warehouse fire, and Leading the Future, with its new Trump-tied data center campaign, will bring similar disasters to communities across America. Our local air and water here have been toxified by corporate projects that would never be built in a more affluent part of the city.

@RepJimmyGomez is complicit in genocide, endorsed by Leading the Future—the AI super PAC of Palantir and OpenAI co-founders—and is under investigation for sexual misconduct.

I can't wait to show my community what a Congressmember can do. Thank you DSA for standing with me. https://t.co/z0KIpT30vo

On a federal level, I would support imposing a moratorium on new AI data centers until we have enforceable federal standards. Furthermore, any facility should be required to disclose its water and energy consumption publicly and continuously. It should pay the full cost of the grid capacity it demands, rather than passing that cost to ratepayers who never agreed to subsidize it.

CA-34, I'm proud to be your 100% corporate-free candidate running to represent the heart of Los Angeles in Congress.

We're up against AIPAC and Big AI lobby money but we can win. https://t.co/qF2CEEuGW4

Los Angeles doesn't belong to AIPAC, Los Angeles doesn’t belong to Crypto or Big AI, Los Angeles doesn’t belong to corporate real estate developers. It belongs to us.

Workers deserve more. We deserve real representation and respect and I think it’s time that we get it. Thank you, CA-34!
